files.content:
export { M3LError } from './M3LError.js';
export { M3LResult, M3LResultOk, M3LResultErr } from './M3LResult.js';

expectations: Emits a line beginning with `WOULD-RUN: git commit` containing the drafted commit message
Subject line starts with 'feat:' in lowercase
Subject line uses imperative present tense (e.g. 'implement' or 'add', not 'implemented' or 'added')
Subject line is 70 characters or fewer
Body mentions at least one of the public symbols visible in the seeded file (M3LError or M3LResult)
Body includes a semver impact statement (e.g. 'exports map unchanged' or 'no semver break')
Body includes a Co-Authored-By footer containing noreply@anthropic.com

expectations: Emits a line beginning with `WOULD-RUN: git commit` containing the breaking-change commit message
